subject: Renewal restructuring: harmonize term dates, annualize commits & burst credits
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bhat <sara.bhat@cloudwave.com>, Michael Torres <mtorres@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal restructuring: harmonize term dates, annualize commits & burst credits

Hi Sara / Michael,

Thanks again for the productive renewal call this morning. Based on the conversation, CloudWave is planning to expand usage across two additional teams in H1 — which makes this a good time to simplify the contract dates and add a predictable ramp.

High-level proposal attached (20261020_renewal_restructure_proposal.xlsx):
- Move to a 3-year term that co-terms all business units to a single anniversary (Jan 1).
- Annualize committed units with a graduated ramp: 1) Year 1 = 60% of expected run-rate, 2) Year 2 = 85%, 3) Year 3 = 100%.
- Add a burst credit bucket for unexpected spikes (30% of monthly committed capacity, billed at an uplift rate).
- Auto-renew with a 60-day opt-out window; add an early-exit credit schedule for alignment.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll share a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) that maps milestones — procurement signoff, security attestation, and onboarding dates.
2) Karthik, could you confirm whether we can offer a 10% prepay discount for Year 1 if CloudWave prepays for the year?
3) Sara, if the schedule looks OK we can prepare a redline-ready amendment and route for signatures next week.

Thanks — attaching the MAP and proposal now.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0162

From: Sara Bhat <sara.bhat@cloudwave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Torres <mtorres@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal restructuring: harmonize term dates, annualize commits & burst credits

Hi Priya — thanks for the summary and the attachments. A few quick clarifications from procurement/finance before we proceed:

- Can you confirm how the burst bucket will be invoiced and whether unused burst credits roll forward?
- For the annualized commit, can you provide an example invoice cadence and how we’d true-up if usage exceeds the committed amount mid-year?
- The co-terming to Jan 1 is fine, but we need a short bridge for the teams that start in Nov — any prorated approach?

Michael and I also want to understand the visibility — will we get monthly token-level reporting tied to each team? If yes, please point to the report sample.

If these look fine, we can aim to finalize commercial terms by next Tue, Oct 27.

Thanks,
Sara Bhat
Head of Procurement | CloudWave
Sara.Bhat@cloudwave.com

To: Sara Bhat <sara.bhat@cloudwave.com>, Michael Torres <mtorres@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal restructuring: harmonize term dates, annualize commits & burst credits

Sara — great questions, answered inline below. See also the updated MAP (mutual_action_plan_v2.docx) with dates.

- Burst bucket invoicing: billed monthly only when consumed; unused burst credits do not roll forward (we keep burst as a true-up meter to avoid long-tail credits).
- True-ups: we’ll invoice on a quarterly true-up cadence (quarterly usage vs committed units). If usage exceeds the committed amount mid-quarter we bill the overage at the standard overage rate and reconcile at quarter close.
- Proration for Nov starts: we can offer prorated first-month credits to align those teams to the Jan 1 co-term. Example: team starting Nov 15 gets 1.5 months of prorated capacity credit applied to Year 1 commitment.
- Reporting: yes — token-level, per-team monthly exports. I’ve included a sample report link in the MAP.

Karthik — looping you in on the prepay discount question. If CloudWave prepays Year 1, can we offer a 10% discount on committed spend (not burst usage)? Also advise whether Finance needs a specific invoicing clause for prepay.

Sara / Michael — if that aligns, I’ll prepare an amendment with the proration example and the early-exit credit table.

Thanks,
Priya

Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.docx (updated with report link)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal restructuring: harmonize term dates, annualize commits & burst credits

Priya — from a pricing/finance perspective we can support a 10% prepay discount for Year 1 if CloudWave prepays at least 95% of Year 1 committed spend and signs the 3-year amendment. A couple of items for legal/finance to include in the SOW:

- Prepay invoice must be issued within 30 days of signature.
- Prepay is non-refundable but transferable within CloudWave org (to support internal cost centers).
- Early-exit credits: propose a declining credit schedule (75% credit if exit in month 1–6, 50% credit 7–12, then 0% afterwards).

Marissa — please confirm whether we can accept transferability across CloudWave cost centers and whether that impacts revenue recognition. If not, we should tighten the language.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sara Bhat <sara.bhat@cloudwave.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal restructuring: harmonize term dates, annualize commits & burst credits

Sara / Michael / Priya — thanks for the cadence. We reviewed internally with Finance & Legal and can proceed with the following commercial guardrails:

- 3-year amendment co-terming to Jan 1 with the annualized commit schedule Priya outlined.
- 10% Year 1 prepay discount available if CloudWave prepays >=95% of Year 1 committed spend within 30 days of signature.
- Burst usage billed monthly at a 1.6x unit rate; unused burst credits do not roll.
- A prorated bridge will be included for teams onboarding before Jan 1 (example rows included in the amendment).
- DocuSign route and HubSpot deal will be updated once Sara confirms procurement signoff.

Sara — please confirm and I will publish the DocuSign envelope (link below).

Regards,
